concerns.text: FR-001 (Global Data Download 1979-2023) and FR-009 (Global Grid Processing) lack completed implementation tasks. T006 (Download) and T007 (Checksum) are marked `[ ]` (incomplete). Without these, the foundational data required for all User Stories (US1-US3) cannot be acquired, making the spec unimplementable.

Core US1 implementation tasks are incomplete (`[ ]`). Specifically, T016a (Z500 Anomaly), T017 (Latitudinal Slicing), T018 (AR Detection), T019 (Pearson Correlation), T020 (BH-FDR), T022 (Save Results), and T023 (Validation) are missing. US1 cannot be executed or tested without these.

All US2 tasks (Visualization) are marked `[ ]` (incomplete). T024-T029 cover test authoring, map masking, generation, legends, and content hashing. No implementation exists for FR-006 (Spatial Maps) or SC-002 (Visualization outputs).

All US3 tasks (Sensitivity Analysis) are marked `[ ]` (incomplete). T031-T036 are required to implement FR-007 (Threshold Sweep) and SC-002 (Robustness measurement). The pipeline cannot verify robustness without these.

Polish tasks for FR-009 (Performance Auditing) and SC-003/SC-004 (Runtime/Memory constraints) are incomplete. T037 (Profiling), T038 (Logs), T039 (Reporting), T040 (CI Validation), and T041 (Quickstart) are all `[ ]`. The project cannot demonstrate compliance with performance constraints.

Data Integrity and Safety tasks are incomplete. T042 (Real Data Enforcement), T043 (Dask Streaming), T044 (Polar Weighting), T045 (FDR Fallback), T046 (Teleconnection Loader), and T047 (Plan Amendment) are all `[ ]`. Critical execution risks (memory, data fabrication, methodological alignment) are unaddressed in the task list.

Task T006 is tagged with `[FR-001-Global]` and `[FR-009]`. While the tag format is slightly non-standard (hyphenated), the intent is clear. However, the task description is incomplete (marked `[ ]`), which is the primary blocker. The tag itself is acceptable as an equivalent form of traceability.
